column1: # Unit 3: En la taquería / At the taco stand. Lexicon rows for the lessons planned in content-plan/units/.
# TAB-separated; columns as in docs/content-style.md section 6. Sections follow the lessons;
# rows under 'supporting' are not introduced by any lesson (no vocabulary items).
# --- u03.l01 ¿Qué quieres? (querer). Also new here, rows in core.tsv: grande, chico, comer, tomar

column12: Not a cake (that is un pastel).
In Mexico City ask con queso: it may come without cheese.
Quiero: I want. Te quiero: I love you.

column1: # --- u03.l02 Me encanta el picante (gustar). Also new here, rows in core.tsv: bueno, rico, picante, picar, salsa, cebolla

column12: Me gusta el café. Plural thing: me gustan los tacos.
In central Mexico, tomate is the green tomatillo.

column1: # --- u03.l03 ¿Me trae la cuenta? (polite requests). Also new here, rows in core.tsv: mesero, cuenta, dar, pasar, llevar

column12: Una orden de tacos: a plate of tacos.
Pagar la cuenta: to pay the check.

column1: # --- supporting (no lesson introduces these; usable from Unit 3 on)

column12: A mí me gusta. Para mí.
Never un otro: otro taco, por favor.
